title: Allow different wallpapers per screen orientation
line: The Image wallpaper can now show a different image when the screen is in portrait orientation.
explanation: The Image wallpaper had one image for every screen shape, so a landscape image rotated to a portrait screen was cropped to a thin middle strip. Wallpaper packages already pick a portrait-sized image by aspect ratio, but there was no way to do that with your own image files. The change adds an optional "Portrait orientation" image to the Image wallpaper settings (a file chooser plus a button to go back to the same image); the wallpaper shows it whenever the desktop is taller than it is wide and switches back on rotation.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: allow a different image in portrait orientation

An image that looks good on a landscape screen is often cropped badly
when the screen is rotated or taller than it is wide. Add an optional
portrait image to the settings, which is shown whenever that is the case.

BUG: 487209

From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:15:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/image: allow a different image in portrait
 orientation

An image that looks good on a landscape screen is often cropped badly
when the screen is rotated or taller than it is wide. Add an optional
portrait image to the settings, which is shown whenever that is the case.

BUG: 487209

diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
index 1c47869b78..ad7e8df924 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -28,6 +28,10 @@
       </tooltip>

+      <label>Wallpaper image path used when the screen is taller than it is wide; empty to use Image</label>
+      <default></default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="PreviewImage" type="String">
       <label>Wallpaper preview image path</label>
       <default>null</default>
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
index 533cc1fff8..99080d2eec 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Controls as QtControls2
+import QtQuick.Dialogs as QtDialogs
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.plasma.wallpapers.image as PlasmaWallpaper
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols as KQuickControls
@@ -32,6 +33,8 @@ ColumnLayout {
     property color cfg_ColorDefault
     property string cfg_Image
     property string cfg_ImageDefault
+    property string cfg_PortraitImage
+    property string cfg_PortraitImageDefault
     property int cfg_FillMode
     property int cfg_FillModeDefault
     property int cfg_SlideshowMode
@@ -234,6 +237,52 @@ ColumnLayout {
             }
         }
 
+        RowLayout {
+            visible: root.configDialog.currentWallpaper === "org.kde.image"
+            spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@label:chooser", "Portrait orientation:")
+
+            QtControls2.Button {
+                icon.name: "document-open"
+                text: root.cfg_PortraitImage === ""
+                    ? i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@action:button", "Use Different Image…")
+                    : decodeURIComponent(root.cfg_PortraitImage.substring(root.cfg_PortraitImage.lastIndexOf("/") + 1))
+                onClicked: portraitImageDialog.open()
+
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@info:tooltip", "Image shown when the screen is taller than it is wide")
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.visible: hovered || visualFocus
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+
+                KCM.SettingHighlighter {
+                    highlight: root.cfg_PortraitImage !== root.cfg_PortraitImageDefault
+                }
+            }
+
+            QtControls2.Button {
+                visible: root.cfg_PortraitImage !== ""
+                icon.name: "edit-clear"
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@action:button", "Use the Same Image")
+                display: QtControls2.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                onClicked: root.cfg_PortraitImage = ""
+
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.text: text
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.visible: hovered || visualFocus
+                QtControls2.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+            }
+
+            QtDialogs.FileDialog {
+                id: portraitImageDialog
+                currentFolder: imageWallpaper.lastFolder
+                nameFilters: imageWallpaper.nameFilters()
+                options: QtDialogs.FileDialog.ReadOnly
+                title: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@title:window", "Open Image for Portrait Orientation")
+                onAccepted: {
+                    root.cfg_PortraitImage = selectedFile.toString();
+                    imageWallpaper.lastFolder = currentFolder;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
         QtControls2.ButtonGroup { id: backgroundGroup }

+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -72,6 +72,9 @@ WallpaperItem {
             if (root.pluginName === "org.kde.slideshow") {
                 return imageWallpaper.image;
             }
+            if (root.configuration.PortraitImage !== "" && root.height > root.width) {
+                return root.configuration.PortraitImage;
+            }
             if (root.configuration.PreviewImage !== "null") {
                 return root.configuration.PreviewImage;
             }
